about.hero_title:
Designing with purpose.
Building with integrity.
about.bio_1: I am Niloufar Zanjani, an architect and interior designer holding a Master's degree in Architecture and a member of the Oman Society of Engineers, with over 13 years of professional experience across residential and commercial projects. My work spans both design and the supervision and execution of interior architecture — an approach that bridges modern art with engineering precision to create spaces that are as functional as they are beautiful.
about.bio_2: Under my personal design brand, NILZ Design, I now lead the architecture department at Al Tariq — a department we built together. Al Tariq is a well-established, reputable name in Oman's real-estate market, attracting investors for more than eight years. Alongside this, I also take on freelance design projects for clients across the Gulf region.
about.bio_3: I believe quality of life is rooted in the spaces we inhabit. I am committed to turning your vision into an enduring reality — through authentic materials, meticulous detail, and the latest in architectural knowledge.

values.title: Contextual Design
values.body: I design with the surroundings in mind — creating spaces that feel rooted in place, culture, and natural light.

values.title: Timeless Aesthetics
values.body: Every detail is carefully considered to ensure longevity, elegance, and a visual language that transcends trends.

values.title: Functional Flow
values.body: From layout to circulation, I prioritise clarity and ease of use — shaping environments that support daily life intuitively.

values.title: Collaborative Process
values.body: I work closely with clients, engineers, and builders — ensuring every decision is aligned with the shared vision.

services.hero_title: Architecture shaped by vision and detail.
services.intro: I deliver thoughtful architectural solutions that solve complex challenges with clarity, creativity, and precision.

items.title: Vision & Scope
items.body: Every project begins with a conversation. I take time to understand how you live and work, your aspirations, and the realities of the site — then translate them into a clear brief and a defined scope. This shared understanding becomes the compass that guides every decision that follows.

items.title: Planning
items.body: Before a single form is drawn, I study the site in depth — its orientation, light, climate, views, and surrounding context — alongside the regulations that shape what's possible. From this analysis I develop a spatial strategy and concept that feels grounded and almost inevitable.

items.title: Designing
items.body: This is where ideas take shape. I develop the architecture and interiors together — massing, layouts, materials, light, and detailing — refining each through drawings and 3D visualization until the design is both bold and timeless.

items.title: Documentation
items.body: I translate the design into precise technical drawings and documentation, coordinating with engineers so every detail is buildable. Through construction I stay involved — supervising quality, resolving details on site — so the project is delivered exactly as envisioned.

process.title: Vision & Scope
process.body: Every project begins with dialogue. I listen, define the brief, and understand the vision — setting the direction for everything that follows.

process.title: Planning
process.body: I study the location, light, landscape and context to create a concept that feels grounded and natural — both functionally and emotionally.

process.title: Designing
process.body: From massing to materials, I shape bold yet timeless spaces that balance aesthetics, purpose, and experience.

process.title: Documentation
process.body: I prepare precise drawings and documentation — collaborating with engineers and consultants to ensure feasibility and performance.

contact.hero_sub: Whether you're hiring, collaborating, or starting a project — I'd love to hear from you.
